enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Present Perfect para descrever mudanças, acontecimentos recentes e situações que evoluíram ao longo do tempo. Também inclui exemplos de vocabulário relevante e a prática de relatar notícias atuais como lição de casa.

vocabulary.definition: To separate into parts with sudden force.
To increase in value, level, or amount.
examples: The bus fare has gone up.

vocabulary.definition: To become better or to make something better.
examples: I want to improve my writing skills.

vocabulary.definition: To develop or increase in size or amount.
To reach a place at the end of a journey.
examples: She arrived at the airport on time.

vocabulary.definition: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control.
examples: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.

grammar.explanation: The Present Perfect tense is used to describe actions or events that have occurred at an unspecified time in the past or that began in the past and continue to the present.
rules: Used for actions with relevance to the present or recent events.
examples: The bus fare has gone up.
commonMistakes: Using the wrong auxiliary verb (e.g., 'She have broken her leg' instead of 'She has broken her leg').
Mixing up the past simple and present perfect (e.g., 'She broke her leg yesterday' vs. 'She has broken her leg').

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: 'Lisa _____ her leg.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Perfect is used because the action has relevance to the present.

practiceQuestions.question: Reescreva a frase no tempo verbal correto: 'The bus fare go up.'
practiceQuestions.answer: The bus fare has gone up.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Use 'has gone' (present perfect) because it indicates a recent change.

culturalNotes: Nos países de língua inglesa, o Present Perfect é frequentemente usado para relatar mudanças ou novidades, especialmente em notícias e conversas informais.
studyTips: Pratique formar o Present Perfect com diferentes verbos irregulares para dominar suas conjugações.
Leia notícias em inglês e identifique frases no Present Perfect para entender o contexto de uso.
originalExamples: Lisa has broken her leg. (Lisa quebrou a perna.)
The bus fare has gone up. (A tarifa do ônibus subiu.)
Her English has improved. (O inglês dela melhorou.)
Dan has grown a beard. (Dan deixou crescer uma barba.)
The letter has arrived. (A carta chegou.)
The temperature has fallen. (A temperatura caiu.)
